violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: DISHES AND UTENSILS CLEANED AND SANITIZED IN THE DISHWASHING MACHINE WITH SANITIZER MEASURED LESS THAN 50PPM AT END OF CLEANING CYCLE AFTER SEVERAL ATTEMPTS.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO PREPARE SANITIZER BASIN OF 3 COMPARTMENT SINK WITH SANITIZER OF APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATION TO SANITIZE DISHES AFTER CLEANING WITH DISHWASHING MACHINE UNTIL SERVICE HAS BEEN COMPLETED.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control (TCS) is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: OBSERVED START AND END TIMES FOR TCS PASTRIES ARE NOT PROPERLY DOCUMENTED TO REFLECT THE TIME THE FOODS ARE TO BE REMOVED FROM SERVICE.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS GUIDED PIC INTO PROPER DOCUMENTING OF START AND END TIME FOR TCS FOODS. ADDITIONAL TPHC RESOURCES WILL BE EMAILED TO PIC. EHS WILL CONFIRM COMPLIANCE BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: UTENSILS STORED IN WATER AT 122F AT COFFEE BAR.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REMOVED UTENSILS FROM CLEANING AND SANITIZING. UTENSILS WERE REPLACED TO BE STORED IN DRY, CLEAN AND SANITIZED CONTAINERS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: DISHWASHING MACHINE UNABLE TO SANITIZE DISHES AT 50-200 PPM AFTER SEVERAL ATTEMPTS.

PLEASE EMAL EHS ONCE SERVICE HAS BEEN COMPLETED.

violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND MAINTAIN AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: BOBA PEARLS AT 122F IN COOKER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC WILL ADD BOBA PEARLS TO TPHC DOCUMENTATION AND USE TPHC PROCEDURES. PIC DISCARDED DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the COFFEE BAR being used TO DUMP, RINSE UTENSILS AND STORE CUTTING BOARDS BEHIND FAUCET.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. CUTTING BOARDS WERE REMOVED FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING. PLEASE ENSURE STAFF IS TRAINED AND COMPLY WITH USING HANDWASH SINK FOR HANDWASHING ONLY.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW POOLED EGGS STORED OVER FRUIT FILLING IN BACK WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REORGANIZED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. EDUCATION PROVIDED. violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food item(s): OBSERVED SEVERAL TCS FOODS USING TPHC PROCEDURES WITHOUT PROPER DOCUMENTATION: RED BEAN BUN, ONION BUN, PIZZA BAGEL, BAKED EGG CROISSANT, MUSHROOM QUICHE, VEGETABLE AND POTATO CROQUETTES, TURKEY QUICHE, SPINACH CROISSANT, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: MILK AT 47F AND HEAVY CREAM AT 45F IN 2 DOOR UNDER COUNTER UNIT NEAR COFFEE STATION.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. MILK WHICH WERE STORED IN UNIT AT 1:00 PM WERE TRANSFERRED TO WALK IN REFRIGERATOR. EHS RECOMMENDED TIME AS A PUBLIC HEALTH CONTROL (TPHC) BE USED FOR MILK STORED IN UNIT UNITL UNIT IS REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN TCS FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW. UPDATE YOUR TPHC DOCUMENTATION TO INCLUDE MILK AND MILK PRODUCTS. MILK MUST HAVE START TEMPERATURE OF 41F OR BELOW. DO NOT STORE MORE SUPPLIES THAN NEEDED FOR 4 HOURS. MILK NOT USED OR SOLD BY 4 HOUR PERIOD ARE TO BE DISCARDED.
